researchers.subject: Texas A&M small town water system digital twin
researchers.verdict: UNSUPPORTED as screened. NSF award 2640086 (Collaborative Research: AI-Enabled Digital Twins for Resilient Freshwater Infrastructure and Communities under Cascading Hazards, Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station, PI Sudipta Chowdhury, obligated $122,169, 2026-09-15 to 2029-08-31) names no utility, town, pipe failure or deployment and describes no validation. Alternative lead: UTEP and El Paso Water NASA funded flood mapping announced 2026-10-08, no demonstrated action, deliverables by 2028.

researchers.subject: Texas A&M Aggie AI Foundry
researchers.verdict: Supported as a facts only mechanism angle with blocking limits. Planned facility, every verb future tense, AI proposes (not chooses) alloys, no opening date, building or measured result, no authenticated picture of the facility (lead photo is Getty stock; ARM-MIP rendering needs permission and shows a different facility). Separate NSF ARM-MIP facility (award 2534344, RELLIS Bryan, $24.9 million) must not be merged. The 3,000 degree Celsius sentence is the university's characterisation and needs verbatim validation.
